panels.description: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE statements per second across databases (aurora_stat_dml_activity).
panels.title: Statement Throughput

panels.description: Average latency per statement type (aurora_stat_dml_activity). A type the instance did not run shows 0.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_select_latency_seconds{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_select_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) or (sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_select_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) == 0) * 0

sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_insert_latency_seconds{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_insert_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) or (sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_insert_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) == 0) * 0

sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_update_latency_seconds{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_update_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) or (sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_update_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) == 0) * 0

sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_delete_latency_seconds{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) / sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_delete_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) or (sum by (service_name) (rate(pg_custom_aurora_dml_activity_delete_count{service_name=~"$service_name"}[$interval])) == 0) * 0

panels.description: Percentage of requests served from the Aurora buffer cache (CloudWatch BufferCacheHitRatio).
panels.title: Buffer Cache Hit Ratio

panels.description: Local storage available to the instance for temporary files and logs (CloudWatch FreeLocalStorage).
panels.title: Free Local Storage

panels.description: Bytes used by the Aurora cluster volume (CloudWatch VolumeBytesUsed). AWS publishes this metric per cluster irregularly, so the line can be up to about 3 hours behind.
panels.title: Cluster volume used

panels.description: CPU utilization of the instance (CloudWatch CPUUtilization). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: CPU utilization

panels.description: Memory available to the instance (CloudWatch FreeableMemory). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: Freeable memory

panels.description: Client connections to the database instance (CloudWatch DatabaseConnections). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: Database connections

panels.description: Read and write I/O operations per second (CloudWatch ReadIOPS, WriteIOPS). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: IOPS

panels.description: Data read from and written to the cluster volume per second (CloudWatch ReadThroughput, WriteThroughput). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Network traffic received and transmitted by the instance per second (CloudWatch NetworkReceiveThroughput, NetworkTransmitThroughput). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: Network throughput

panels.description: Outstanding I/O requests waiting for access to the disk (CloudWatch DiskQueueDepth). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: Disk queue depth

panels.description: Swap space used by the instance (CloudWatch SwapUsage). Source: CloudWatch, available without Enhanced Monitoring; values are about 10 minutes behind.
panels.title: Swap usage
